run_ZeroEvenOpTest: run the ZeroEvenOpTest unit tests to verify the ZeroEven Caffe2 operator on CPU
test_ZeroEven_op_cpu: test the ZeroEven operator on CPU by setting even-indexed values to zero in a 1D array
test_ZeroEven_op_gpu: test the ZeroEven operator on GPU by setting even-indexed values to zero in a 1D array
test_non_1D_array_error: test that the ZeroEven operator throws a RuntimeError when given a non-1D array input
test_empty_array_handling: test that the ZeroEven operator correctly handles empty 1D float32 arrays
